quotes.text: Do not punish every crooked echo.
Suspicion told each traveler to close a fist.
In the fifth season, Nara found that the lantern trees had joined their roots
Give fully, return half, forgive the wind, and judge hearts by seasons.
Nara carved no command that year.
A young traveler asked, “Why trust a bridge when numbers wander?”

note: Give fully/return half/forgive the wind; no sanction ever; Vey the wind tempts suspicion; R10 drops the carved command.

quotes.text: Do not punish the crooked echo — answer the shape of the gift.
Each sent less, and less, until the river carried nothing and ran dry between them
When a thin net returned, Ana forgave it once, and twice.
Give everything, every time. Return half, every time.
In the sixth season the moon-bowl needed no keeper, for the road had learned its own law.
Their hands were the lesson. The children copied the hands, not the sermon.
One lean crossing is weather. Ten lean crossings are character.
*Then how do you know,* the stranger said, *that you have not been cheated?

note: Mutual withholding spiral in R1 origin story, then give all/return half; stone goes blank, habit replaces rule; ledger-burning stranger.
